preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n must be between 2 and 30000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**8 <= ai <= 10**8 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the sequence must be an integer between -10^8 and 10^8.
All elements in the sequence must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' if not can_split(a) else True
postconditions.description: If the sequence cannot be split into two arithmetic progressions, output 'No solution'.

postconditions.expression: len(progressions) == 2 and all(len(p) >= 1 for p in progressions)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output two non-empty arithmetic progressions.
Each output progression must be a valid arithmetic progression.
